evidence.notes: Source-backed Apex DTO classes are registered for exec fixtures and typed deserialization maps inherited fields, properties, nested DTO lists, sets, maps, and missing defaults.
Strict source-backed DTO deserialization rejects unknown nested DTO fields with catchable JSONException.
Source-backed DTO deserialize/serialize roundtrip preserves nested fields and suppresses Apex object null fields when requested.

source.content: public class JsonDTOBase { public String ExternalId; }
public class JsonDTOAddress { public String City { get; set; } public Integer Zip; }

public class JsonDTO extends JsonDTOBase { public String Name { get; set; } public JsonDTOAddress Primary; public List<JsonDTOAddress> Addresses; public Set<String> Tags; public Map<String, Integer> Scores; public String Missing; }
